name: Eggs in a Heart with Bacon, Avocado & Strawberry Preserves

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet it hot, add bacon and cook until golden and crispy, 3-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet with drippings for later use.)
Meanwhile, using a heart-shaped cookie cutter, cut out the center of each bread slice.
Return skillet (with drippings) to medium heat. Add bread slices and cut-outs to the skillet. Cook until toasted on the bottom side, about 2 minutes.

Flip bread and cut-outs, then crack one egg into the center of each bread slice; season eggs with salt and pepper. Cover and continue to cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, halve, and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and thinly slice. Sprinkle with salt.
To serve, divide bacon, egg toasts, cut-outs, and avocado between plates. Enjoy!
